content: {"findings":[{"category":"correctness","claim":"Replacing `saturating_sub` with plain `-` makes `tail` panic whenever `count > items.len()`: debug builds panic on usize underflow, and release builds wrap `start` to a huge value, so `&items[start..]` panics on the out-of-range slice; previously the call returned the whole slice.","end_line":2,"line":2,"path":"src/lib.rs","prior_id":null,"quote":"    let start = items.len() - count;","severity":"high","side":"new","suggestion":"    let start = items.len().saturating_sub(count);"}]}
